name: Sada (A Coruña, Spain)
description: Blue field with a yellow two-masted ship with white sails above two white waves, flanked by two yellow open towers.
history: The arms and the flag were approved on 14 July 2011 (Diario Oficial de Galicia of 1 August 2011); the flag is a blue cloth with a yellow two-masted ship with white sails in the wind above two white waves, flanked by two yellow donjoned and open towers, the whole representing the entrance to the bay of Sada.
